record.question: The _________ should contain sufficient alpha guides for speedy reference. It is good to have a guide after every 20 cards.
record.explanation: Answer A: Master Patient Index. The Master Patient Index provides a central index with identifying information and guides for locating an individual patient record. Reference: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/208125/9290610050_rev_eng.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
